duration.text: The Chemistry at Nanjing University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number&expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Academic transcript of high school5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicant should hold high school graduation certificate with excellent performance and good health, and have valid foreign passport. Applicant should hold HSK level 3 certificate;
